Portfolio news brief — 11 September 2026

Market and major-name developments
- Treasury yields were remained at or near multiyear highs Friday, as bond markets assessed the latest consumer price report for August. Odds that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates by a quarter percentage point at its policy meeting next week shot up to 90% from about 72% on Thursday, based on trading in 30-day fed funds futures at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange. (CNBC)
- Some great income-generating opportunities are emerging as bond yields move higher. (CNBC)
- CNBC's Steve Liesman reports on news regarding the U.S. (CNBC)
- Stretched earnings expectations, extreme concentration and surging equity issuance point to growing bubble risks. (CNBC)
- OpenAI is taking aim at some of Wall Street's most labor-intensive tasks with a new version of ChatGPT designed to research companies, analyze financial data and generate the presentations that investment bankers rely on. The product unveiled Thursday, called ChatGPT for Financial Services, is a tailored version of its enterprise product, ChatGPT Work, that was made with "design partners" Morgan Stanley and Evercore , according to OpenAI's vice president of product, Nick Turley. (CNBC)

Meta (META)
- Meta Platforms ( META +0.85% ) launched Muse on Sept. 8 -- a personal artificial intelligence (AI) agent that can send emails, book travel, fill out forms, and negotiate on your behalf. (The Motley Fool)

NVIDIA (NVDA; VOO top-five holding)
- Chinese chipmaker Enflame, which is developing domestic alternatives to U.S. rivals like Nvidia, has seen its stock soar 206% after debuting in Shanghai. (CNBC)

Bitcoin (BTC)
- Bitcoin 's price has shown recent strength, with the cryptocurrency rising roughly 20% over the past month and back near the $80,000 level . For the volatile digital asset class, sharp moves are nothing new and bitcoin's performance in 2026 remains negative. (CNBC)
- inflation data gave the market a mixed bag today, with the core monthly reading coming in hotter than economists had penciled in, but with most numbers generally in line with expectations. Bitcoin initially dipped on the news, but has since bounced back and is once again nearing $79,000, as the broader market digests what it means for the Federal Reserve’s forthcoming decision on interest rates next week. (Decrypt)

Alphabet (GOOGL; VOO top-five holding)
- Alex Turner, Google DeepMind former research scientist, joins 'Power Lunch' to discuss the scientists concerns with AI, the impact of recent incidents and much more. (CNBC)

Informational only — verify primary sources before making investment decisions.
Routine price moves and stock-picking speculation are intentionally excluded.
